title: Reflected Schrodinger Bridge Problem over Sub-Riemannian Manifold
summary: We formulate and solve the reflected sub-Riemannian Schrödinger bridge (SB) problem: minimum-energy transport of probability distributions on a bounded domain for underactuated dynamics with degenerate diffusion and hard state constraints. The main difficulties are geometric and degeneracy: Euclidean normal reflection is generally incompatible with the horizontal subbundle, since it may push the process in directions not generated by the admissible control and noise fields.
